mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained RSAFS growth over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals a supply shock, which increases input costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it indicates high inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.1%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last three months signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts related industries and the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained HOUST growth over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 2% in the last month, it signals a recessionary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO decrease > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 is negative for two consecutive quarters and INDPRO decreases by more than 2% within the last month.
